title: 🧹 [code health improvement] Remove console.log in fdir.js
body:
🎯 **What:** Removed an unnecessary `console.log` statement from `src/core/fdir.js` at line 69.
💡 **Why:** The file restoration event was already being properly captured by pushing an object with the restored state into the `reparacionesEjecutadas` array, which is then returned by the method. The `console.log` was redundant and removing it improves code maintainability by eliminating unnecessary output to stdout.
✅ **Verification:** Verified the code health issue was resolved by deleting the line, running all automated tests `npm test`, strict verifications `npm run verify:strict`, and CI checks `npm run ci`, all of which successfully passed with zero failures. Reverted documentation artifacts modified by the test runs to leave a clean diff.
✨ **Result:** Improved code cleanliness and predictability by preventing superfluous standard output during recovery cycles, with no impact to actual behavior or error tracking functionality.
